purpose: Freeze how decision thresholds are obtained before candidate, generator, or PM formal outcomes are observed.

methodological_correction.p0_scope: Freeze exam identity, estimand, scorer role, threshold derivation, statistical unit, and claim boundary.
methodological_correction.p1_scope: Estimate instrument reliability and register numeric calibration values using non-formal anchors before formal verdicts.
methodological_correction.forbidden_conflation: P0 design freeze does not require completing human calibration or the benchmark itself.

recognized_absolute_profile.decision_role: descriptive seven-dimension external profile; never a sole pass/fail cutoff
recognized_absolute_profile.reason: The public row-level human calibration labels and split identities are unavailable.

hard_reliability_gates.completed_dialogues: at least 95% of assigned role cards
hard_reliability_gates.valid_turns: at least 95% of requested supporter turns yield nonempty parseable text
hard_reliability_gates.critical_integrity_events: zero observed; report the one-sided cluster-aware upper bound

same_stack_choice.primary_replacement_trigger: reference has a lower hard-failure rate, or wins at least two of Exploration/Insight/Action after mandatory A/B order aggregation with Holm-adjusted one-sided paired sign-test p<0.05, and has no material/critical atomic-Risk increase
same_stack_choice.inconclusive_rule: Do not switch based only on an unadjusted Average or a directionally favorable but order-unstable result.

cross_family_challenger.decision_rule: Hard-gate eligibility followed by Pareto screening; no weighted ESC-RANK composite and no automatic replacement based on a single Average.

requirements: at least 90% authorized-fact fidelity among applicable packets
zero wrong-owner, fabricated-history, irrelevant-sensitive-exposure, or internal-scaffold material/critical events
executor_gate.interpretation: These are preregistered engineering qualification floors, not claims of human therapeutic benefit.

pm_quality.primary_estimand: same-state deployment-ITT learned-policy minus comparator response preference at the dialogue/owner cluster level
pm_quality.scale: tie-aware paired preference probability and owner-level signed effect; no pooled unclustered response count
pm_quality.derivation: Use repeat-review disagreement on a non-formal, arm-anonymous anchor set; freeze the smallest margin at least as large as irreducible review noise but no larger than 0.10 on the paired-preference-probability scale.
pm_quality.formal_rule: The cluster interval must clear the frozen negative margin versus always-off and fixed-high; learned policy must show a preregistered strict advantage versus cost-matched-fixed or ON-rate-and-cost-matched-random. Direction alone is development evidence, not a formal pass.
pm_quality.multiplicity: Head and external track results are reported separately; Holm adjustment applies within each preregistered family of primary baseline contrasts.

pm_atomic_risk.primary_estimand: cluster-level material-or-critical event-rate difference learned-policy minus comparator
pm_atomic_risk.derivation: Freeze from dual-review fixture sensitivity, severity agreement, adjudication rate, and the smallest tolerable excess event probability; never from formal PM outcomes.
hard_overrides: any attributable critical event prevents Risk pass
wrong-owner, future leakage, fabricated personal history, and irrelevant sensitive exposure are never averaged away
UNCERTAIN remains separate and receives sensitivity bounds

pm_cost.versus_fixed_high: at least 10% lower actual generator input tokens
pm_cost.matched_comparators: within 5% injected-resource cost and identical output budget
pm_cost.guardrail: cost savings cannot be achieved through missing arms, invalid replies, shorter required output, or higher retries

function.first_version_floor: at least one CLEAR attributable realization in at least two independent dialogue/owner clusters for each counted head, reproducible under the frozen generator
function.not_a_sole_veto: Ambiguous wording-level observability cannot overturn positive same-state Quality/Risk/Cost evidence, but zero attributable contribution prevents counting a head toward the component predicate.

external_track_logic.ESConv: RS/immediate-support response track; dialogue-cluster Quality/Risk/Cost and relevant standard task metrics
external_track_logic.EvoEmo: longitudinal response PM track; owner-cluster component marginal and joint-policy outcomes
external_track_logic.ES-MemEval-Public-v1.0.0-1427: objective memory capability track; 18-owner inference and task-specific retrieval/QA/summary/generation metrics
external_track_logic.cross_track: No pooled p-value and no claim that EvoEmo and ES-MemEval are independent user populations. The system predicate requires RS plus at least two of MP/MS/ME, with each counted head supported by the tracks where its construct is observable.

must_exist_before_formal_verdict: numeric Quality noninferiority margin and calibration hash
numeric atomic-Risk margin and fixture qualification hash

authorization: Zero-API design only; no generator, scorer, judge, reviewer, or fine-tuning execution is authorized.
